g.title: j3532789785
g.text: How are you and Roathe getting along, lately?

g.title: j4170257612
g.text: Things in this false crypt are much improved, I must say. Or perhaps that is simply my perception of things. I have been... distracted of late.

g.title: j3032743143
g.text: Things in this false crypt are much improved, I must say. You have been giving him an outlet for his frustrations, have you not?

g.title: j1069459167
g.text: You have brought him a manner of surety. Purpose. And for this, I could not be more grateful. And I know the same goes for Marie.

g.title: j2591330860
g.text: Not much has changed, I fear. I think that poor beast is liable to rip himself apart in his angst before long.

g.title: j2433407510
g.text: Forgive me. That is laced with innuendo that I did not mean to imply. I simply meant to say that you have been counseling him quite successfuly.

g.title: j3996887791
g.text: If Marie does not drive him to it first.

g.title: j2264608016
g.text: You have brought him a manner of self-reflection. Direction. And for this, I could not be more grateful. And I know the same goes for Marie.

g.title: j3527128181
g.text: You have brought him a manner of surety. Purpose. And for this, I could not be more grateful. And I know the same goes for Marie.

g.title: j3486888134
g.text: I do not know what will come of his fate. I hope we can resolve it. For I worry what he will twist himself into if left to his own devices overlong.

g.title: j2294232367
g.text: I am. Going to simply retreat from this computer for the rest of the evening.

g.title: j1975767312
g.text: We have much to be thankful for, when it comes to you.

g.title: j4031790002
g.text: We have much to be thankful for, when it comes to you, mon miracle.
